Animal travel notice for Aurelia Skyways

Travelers need to check pet plans with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before arrival, since every journey needs the right papers and a calm handoff. Keep carriers secure, keep records ready, and tell the desk at once if anything changes.

<<FACT F059>> Bring bird travel details to the desk early so the team can review the file without delay. We handle each case as a shared duty, and clear notes help the process move smoothly.

<<FACT F073>> For cat travel, follow the desk advice before you leave home, because missing details can slow the check-in. If you are bringing a pet on board, please keep food, water, and carrier notes close at hand.

Aurelia Skyways treats every animal move with care, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is ready to guide travelers through the next step. Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk as soon as possible for the latest instructions.
